brief.title: Nike Inc. (NKE) Historical Stock Performance Analysis (2000–2026)
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of Nike's stock price trends, volatility, and trading volume over a 26-year period to inform long-term investment perspectives.
brief.goal: Provide investors with a clear understanding of Nike's historical stock performance, identify key growth phases and downturns, assess volatility patterns, and highlight long-term return characteristics to support informed investment decision-making.

required_sections.title: Executive Summary
required_sections.objective: Summarize the overall stock performance trajectory from 2000 to 2026, including cumulative returns and key milestones.

required_sections.title: Long-Term Price Trend Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze the closing price trend over the full time period, identifying major bull and bear phases, all-time highs and lows, and structural shifts in valuation.

required_sections.title: Volatility and Risk Assessment
required_sections.objective: Examine daily price ranges (High–Low spread), rolling volatility measures, and periods of elevated risk such as market crises.

required_sections.title: Trading Volume Patterns
required_sections.objective: Analyze trading volume trends over time, identify periods of unusually high or low activity, and correlate volume spikes with price movements.

required_sections.title: Annual and Decade-Level Performance Breakdown
required_sections.objective: Provide year-over-year and decade-level return summaries, highlighting the best and worst performing years and compounding growth rates.

required_sections.title: Key Takeaways and Investment Implications
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable insights for long-term investors, including risk-return profile assessment and notable patterns.

kpis.name: Cumulative Return
kpis.description: Total percentage return from the first trading day in 2000 to the most recent data point, based on closing prices.

kpis.name: Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
kpis.description: Annualized growth rate of the closing price over the full dataset period.

kpis.name: Maximum Drawdown
kpis.description: The largest peak-to-trough decline in closing price observed during the dataset period.

kpis.name: Average Daily Trading Volume
kpis.description: Mean daily trading volume across the entire period, with comparison across different eras.

kpis.name: Annualized Volatility
kpis.description: Standard deviation of daily returns annualized (×√252) as a measure of overall stock risk.
